# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# art.txt - facts about each generated image, MEASURED by art_probe.
#
# Do not edit by hand. When an image changes, regenerate this file:
#
#     build/Release/art_probe --art > assets/lanebattle/art.txt
#
# The generator was asked for 288-pixel grids and delivered 1254-pixel ones,
# so the only trustworthy numbers are the ones read off the pixels.
#
#   frame_width, frame_height  one cell
#   columns, rows              frames per row; a unit has one row per pose:
#                              idle, walk, attack, hurt, stunned, death
#   anchor_x, anchor_y         the point placed on the target, in cell
#                              pixels: a unit's FEET, an effect's centre
#   figure                     a unit's standing height, or an effect's
#                              larger side - what on-screen sizes scale
#   ping_pong                  looping rows to play back and forth, because
#                              their last drawing does not lead back into
#                              their first (see art_probe --motion)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
